Clipper2 2.0.1
===============

This directory vendors the C++ Clipper2 library files needed by
`mower_logic` area recording. The source was imported from:

https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2

Imported tag:

`Clipper2_2.0.1` (`21ebba05db8894f0c7217ad35ea518080f324946`)

Only the core C++ library headers and sources are included. Examples, tests,
utilities, and build-system files are intentionally omitted.
